Definition: from G4183 and probably a derivative of G4120; manifold, i.e. (neuter as noun) very much more:--manifold more.
BiblicalUsage: Pollaplasion means manifold more, many times over. Jesus promises it to everyone who has left house or family for the kingdom: they receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God never asks us to give up anything without giving back far more than we gave.
